bank_connection_accounts_days_chk.name: bank_connection_accounts_days_chk
bank_connection_accounts_days_chk.value: ("bank_connection_accounts"."closing_day" is null or "bank_connection_accounts"."closing_day" between 1 and 31) and ("bank_connection_accounts"."due_day" is null or "bank_connection_accounts"."due_day" between 1 and 31)

bank_connection_accounts_link_chk.name: bank_connection_accounts_link_chk
bank_connection_accounts_link_chk.value: ("bank_connection_accounts"."kind" = 'bank' or "bank_connection_accounts"."linked_account_id" is null) and ("bank_connection_accounts"."kind" = 'credit_card' or "bank_connection_accounts"."linked_credit_card_id" is null)

import_batches_file_chk.name: import_batches_file_chk
import_batches_file_chk.value: "import_batches"."origin" <> 'file' or ("import_batches"."format" is not null and "import_batches"."file_name" is not null)

open_finance_events_size_chk.name: open_finance_events_size_chk
open_finance_events_size_chk.value: length("open_finance_events"."event_id") between 1 and 200 and length("open_finance_events"."event_type") between 1 and 100

transactions_installments_chk.name: transactions_installments_chk
transactions_installments_chk.value: ("transactions"."installment_number" is null or "transactions"."installment_number" > 0) and ("transactions"."installment_total" is null or "transactions"."installment_total" > 0) and ("transactions"."occurrence_index" is null or "transactions"."occurrence_index" >= 0)

transactions_external_id_chk.name: transactions_external_id_chk
transactions_external_id_chk.value: "transactions"."external_id" is null or length("transactions"."external_id") between 1 and 200

transactions_import_chk.name: transactions_import_chk
transactions_import_chk.value: "transactions"."origin" <> 'manual' or ("transactions"."import_batch_id" is null and "transactions"."external_id" is null)
